11206: Kaiba is the main character of the Kaiba series. He has a hole in the middle of his chest and a tattoo of three circles forming a triangle on his belly. Kaiba has chin-length yellow hair styled in a bob and blue-green eyes.
11208: Neiro is a skilled martial artist. She's affiliated with Issoudan and frequently completes missions involving stealth and the use of explosives. She shares an unknown connection with Kaiba. Neiro has medium orange hair styled in two horizontal pigtails and brown eyes.
11210: Popo is the public voice for Issoudan, an anti-memory chip organization. He's the first to encounter Kaiba upon awakening. Popo explains the nature of the world to Kaiba and that his life is in danger.
12632: Chroniko is a character and a body Kaiba uses. She's introduced selling Shabo in a crowded marketplace on her home planet.
12941: Patch is a robot that designs bodies for people to buy on the planet Abipa. He runs on a battery and he loses his memory when it runs out, so his dog companion Quilt is tasked to recharge him.
13029: The sadistic sheriff on board Neuron. Though Vanilla is extremely strict in enforcing his authority upon the passengers (and enjoys doing so thoroughly), he is not above corruption, and is willing to make deals, accept bribery, or steal memory chips for himself.
16529: Hyo-hyo is a yellow-green (occasionally white in animation) creature; her body shape is similar to a bell with ribbons or a sprouting plant. Hyo-hyo is able to fly using two vertical limbs on top of her head (or her legs) that act like a helicopter propeller.

134834: A stuffed animal-like body that resembles a hippo. Kaiba uses this body to smuggle himself in the ship. It is very difficult for him to move around in this state, and he is also incapable of speech or expressing facial emotion.
141828: The copy of Warp who secretly takes power in Kaiba's absence. He's cold and willing to hurt others to achieve his goals.
184269: Parm is a character who's commissioned by Popo to help Kaiba escape the pursuers chasing him. She agrees, hiding Kaiba under her coat to smuggle him aboard Neuron. Parm has heavy-lidded yellow eyes and pink and violet hair that she wears in pigtails.
184273: Lum is a character who appears in the episode "Stowaways". Lum has green hair, green lipstick, green eyeshadow, and purple eyes. Her green hair is styled into a bob, with side bangs that cover one of her eyes. She has a beauty mark on the lower right of her mouth.
184374: Akanbou, often known as Baby, is a character who appears in episode 5. Baby has a body that looks like a baby. He's bald, has pale skin, and no eyebrows. He wears a small black leotard with a white frilled collar. He also wears gray socks.
184653: Mantle is a character who recognizes the birthmark on Kaiba's stomach. He chases Kaiba and Hyo-hyo hoping to capture and sell his body. Mantle has purple hair that he wears in a mullet. He wears a signature purple cape.
